title: TikTok — why 'fresh inspection' actually matters
hook: "Fresh 48-month" — here's why that phrase can be worth six figures.
body: Quick one: what a 'fresh inspection' really does to the price of a jet.

script.visual: Talking head or exterior of the Challenger, fast cut
script.voiceover: You see 'fresh 48-month inspection' on a jet listing — here's why that phrase can be worth six figures.
Big inspections are due on a calendar, whether you fly the airplane or not. Miss where one falls and you inherit the bill.
script.onscreen: Due by calendar, not just hours

script.voiceover: This Challenger 604 had its 48-month done by Duncan, plus engines on GE OnPoint and MSP. That's a fresh clock and program coverage — the two things that protect your number at resale.
That's the stuff we read before you ever make an offer. Vertical Jet Sales.
